[Act: income-tax-1961
 Chapter: Liability in Special Cases
 Section: 166::Direct assessment or recovery not barred.
]


Nothing in the foregoing sections in this Chapter shall prevent eitherthe direct assessment of the person on whose behalf or for whose benefit income therein referred to is receivable, or the recovery from such person of the tax payable in respect of such income.

metadata.section_title: Direct assessment or recovery not barred.
